The plan

Our flagship in Old Town Yucca Valley, opening early 2027. Four residencies, a pop-up table, and an event floor for brands and artists with a point of view.

  • Window residency. The other front corner, about 12 by 12 ft (roughly 140 sq ft), with its own 8 ft storefront window and about 12 ft of wall.
  • Residencies 2, 3 and 4. About 6 ft each on the long wall. Take one, or two side by side.
  • Pop-up table. A movable table on casters for day or week pop-ups.
  • Event floor. About 600 sq ft in the center of the room for launches, dinners, and screenings. The wall beside our corner is the screen, and an art wall between screenings.
  • Back of house. A restroom, storage, and a rear door for load-in.
